title: World War II: A Global Conflict (1939–1945)

designPlan.subject: World War II overview
designPlan.purpose: Provide a concise educational summary of the war's timeline and key facts.
designPlan.keyMessage: World War II was a transformative global conflict that reshaped the modern world order.

slides.title: The Global Conflict
slides.subtitle: A summary of the most widespread war in human history

content.bodyText: World War II involved the vast majority of the world's countries and every great power, forming two opposing military alliances: the Allies and the Axis. It was the deadliest conflict in history, resulting in an estimated 70 to 85 million fatalities.

timeline.title: Invasion of Poland
timeline.description: Germany invades Poland, prompting Britain and France to declare war.

timeline.title: Global Escalation
timeline.description: Germany invades the Soviet Union; Japan attacks Pearl Harbor, bringing the US into the war.

timeline.title: Turning Points
timeline.description: Allied victories at Stalingrad, Midway, and El Alamein shift the momentum.

timeline.title: D-Day
timeline.description: Allied forces land in Normandy, beginning the liberation of Western Europe.

timeline.title: Victory
timeline.description: Germany surrenders in May; Japan surrenders in September following atomic bombings.

bullets: Axis Powers: Germany, Italy, and Japan.
Allied Powers: Great Britain, Soviet Union, United States, and China.
The war led to the creation of the United Nations to foster international cooperation.
The aftermath saw the emergence of the United States and the Soviet Union as global superpowers.
content.takeaway: The war ended the era of European colonial dominance and set the stage for the Cold War.
